plugin.name: Temporal Memory
plugin.description: Memory impact: the quotes submitted by the model on every observe call are stored in plaintext in this plugin's private local directory, one database per character; they are not encrypted, not uploaded, and never auto-injected into the chat. A single permanent delete wipes freed pages, clears old FTS segments and truncates the WAL, but exported JSON, migrated backups and disk snapshots may still contain plaintext. Features: evidence-first layered temporal memory with verbatim quotes, dormancy for events/preferences, pin without decay, conflicts pending confirmation, and pull-only recall. Note: writing depends on the model calling observe every turn - no call, no record (coverage is not guaranteed); quotes are submitted by the caller and not verified against the chat log by the host.
plugin.short_description: Writes local memory: plaintext quotes per character; delete clears pages/FTS/WAL, exports and backups stay plaintext. Needs observe every turn; pull-only recall.
entry.observe.name: Record a conversation turn
entry.observe.description: Store one turn in the plugin's private database and extract preferences/facts/events from the user's original words. No content is pushed into the chat. The model must call it every turn; no call means no record.
entry.remember.name: Remember this
entry.remember.description: Write an anchor with verbatim evidence when the user explicitly asks to remember; pinned=true keeps it permanently. Demoted to ungrouped pending when it does not match recent user lines in working memory.
entry.recall.name: Preview recall
entry.recall.description: Settings-page recall preview; hidden from the model.
entry.timeline.name: Read timeline
entry.timeline.description: Settings-page timeline view; hidden from the model.
entry.confirm_memory.name: Confirm memory
entry.confirm_memory.description: Confirm after checking the quote; refresh confirmation time and leave dormant/pending state.
entry.pin_memory.name: Pin memory
entry.pin_memory.description: Pinned memories never auto-sleep or decay.
entry.correct_memory.name: Correct memory
entry.correct_memory.description: Fix the summary, verbatim quote or type; undoable.
entry.archive_memory.name: Remove memory
entry.archive_memory.description: Remove from recall while keeping evidence and an undo record.
entry.delete_memory.name: Delete one memory for good
entry.delete_memory.description: Delete this memory with its links and undo snapshot immediately; requires confirmed=true. Reports remaining working-memory lines holding the same quote.
entry.delete_working_turn.name: Delete one working-memory line
entry.delete_working_turn.description: Delete a single working-memory line by row id; requires confirmed=true. Does not clear the whole database.
entry.clear_memories.name: Clear all memories
entry.clear_memories.description: Clear every character database and reclaim file space; requires confirmed=true and cannot be undone.
entry.purge_memories.name: Purge old memories
entry.purge_memories.description: Delete unpinned items removed over 30 days ago or not confirmed for 365 days; loaded databases only.
entry.resolve_conflict.name: Resolve conflict
entry.resolve_conflict.description: Keep one side of a pending conflict and archive the other.
entry.resolve_orphan.name: Resolve ungrouped pending item
entry.resolve_orphan.description: Keep an ungrouped pending item as active, or archive it out of recall.
entry.undo_last.name: Undo last action
entry.undo_last.description: Undo the latest panel correction, pin, removal or conflict resolution.
entry.update_settings.name: Save settings
entry.update_settings.description: Write back the master switch and thresholds; affects this plugin's configuration only.
entry.export_memories.name: Export memories
entry.export_memories.description: Export all memories with verbatim evidence as JSON; unmounted character databases are opened temporarily and included.
entry.attach_database.name: Attach character database
entry.attach_database.description: Add an unmounted character database from the panel to the current memory list on demand, without changing startup behaviour.
ui.title: Temporal Memory
ui.subtitle: Verbatim evidence + dormancy + conflict confirmation, no chat injection
ui.status.title: Memory status
ui.status.legacy_ignored: An old memory.db coexists with character databases: only character databases are mounted, the old one is not loaded and does not appear below.
ui.status.unique_index_skipped: The old database has duplicate event rows, so the unique index could not be created. New writes still check for duplicates first, but exporting and cleaning up the duplicates is recommended.
ui.status.read_errors: {{count}} character database(s) failed to load and were skipped; other characters still show. See the plugin log for details.
ui.status.maintenance_errors: Maintenance failed for {{count}} character database(s) on the latest run and was skipped; it is not retried while the master switch is off, and the record clears after the next successful run.
ui.status.pending_overdue: {{overdue}} pending items have been waiting for more than {{days}} days (the oldest for {{oldest}} days). Neither side is recalled until you resolve them, so pick one below soon.
ui.status.pending_notice: {{count}} pending items; these statements are not recalled until resolved.
ui.recall.title: How recall works
ui.recall.hint: This plugin never calls push_message and never pushes memories into the chat. Content is returned only when the user explicitly asks about the past and the model calls the recall tool; the panel preview is for inspection and is not counted as a recall.
ui.unloaded.title: Unmounted character databases
ui.unloaded.hint: {{count}} databases on disk are not mounted: they take no part in recall and are missing from the list above. What you see is a read-only snapshot (up to 30 seconds old) that does not modify the files; press "Attach this database" to work on its items.
ui.unloaded.counts: anchors {{anchors}} | preferences/facts {{semantics}} | pending {{pending}} ({{groups}} conflict groups) | working memory {{turns}} lines
ui.unloaded.empty: This database has no anchors yet
ui.conflict.title: Pending conflicts
ui.conflict.hint: When statements conflict, both sides pause recall. Adopt one and the other is archived; a wrong choice can be undone. A pinned old entry is never frozen: the new statement is listed as ungrouped pending instead.
ui.conflict.truncated: More than 120 conflict groups; only the first 120 are shown and the rest appear as you resolve them.
ui.orphan.title: Ungrouped pending items
ui.orphan.hint: These items have no conflict group but still take capacity and are never recalled normally. Keeping one turns it into an active memory; archiving removes it from recall. When a pinned statement is contradicted, the old entry stays active and keeps being recalled while the new statement appears here; resolving here never touches the pinned old entry.
ui.orphan.truncated: More than 120 ungrouped items; only the oldest 120 are shown and the rest appear as you resolve them.
ui.working.title: Working memory (recent verbatim turns)
ui.working.hint: Each character keeps the last {{window}} lines (one line for the user, one for the assistant, about {{turns}} turns). The text is stored in plaintext in the plugin's private sqlite and also appears in the exported JSON. The window scrolls by lines, not by turns; the text is supplied by the model each turn and the plugin cannot verify it against the host chat log, so delete anything suspicious permanently.
ui.memory.title: Memories and evidence
ui.memory.hint: Every entry shows its quote, source and remaining dormancy days. Corrections, pins and removals all leave an undo record. Recall only bumps the recall counter and never refreshes the last-confirmed time: the dormancy countdown resets only when you confirm in the panel or the model re-confirms.
ui.memory.truncated: Pinned entries come first, the rest by time, at most 240 here. Pinned entries are never auto-purged; unpin or resolve the shown entries to reveal older ones.
ui.memory.empty: No memories yet. Enable writes and chat for a few turns.
ui.memory.export_warning: The exported file is plaintext JSON containing every memory and quote; keep it somewhere trusted and never upload it to public drives or chat groups.
ui.memory.purge_hint: When capacity is tight, purge old entries that have been removed or dormant for a long time.
ui.memory.sensitive_hint: Exports skip milestone, anniversary, birthday, emotional and high-intensity entries by default; turn this on only for a full backup.
ui.memory.clear_sensitive_hint: Permanently deletes quotes and inferences whose text mentions birthdays, anniversaries, weddings or confessions, or whose tags mark milestones, anniversaries or strong emotion, across every local character database.
ui.memory.clear_hint: Wipe every character database; effective immediately and cannot be undone.
ui.memory.hypothesis_delete_in: Hypothesis area | deleted in about {{days}} days, never recalled
ui.archived.title: Removed memories (can be deleted permanently)
ui.archived.hint: These entries are out of recall, but their quotes are still stored in plaintext in the plugin sqlite. They are not recalled and take no capacity. Press "Delete this permanently" to wipe them now, or wait for the 30-day purge.
ui.archived.truncated: More than 120 removed entries; only the latest 120 are shown and earlier ones appear after deletion.
ui.strategy.title: Writes and lifecycle
ui.strategy.disabled_hint: When disabled, no new memories are written and model recall is refused; existing memories stay in the panel and can still be corrected, removed or deleted permanently.
ui.save.title: Save
ui.save.hint: Changes apply to this plugin's configuration only, not to the host or other plugins.
ui.confirm.purge_message: Permanently deletes unpinned memories in every loaded character database that were removed over 30 days ago or have not been confirmed for 365 days. This cannot be undone; export JSON first.
ui.confirm.clear_sensitive_message: Permanently deletes, in every on-disk character database, anchors and preferences/facts whose text mentions birthdays, anniversaries, weddings or confessions, whose tags mention birthday/anniversary/emotion, or whose emotion score is at least 0.75, plus matching working-memory turns and the assistant reply immediately after them; migration backups that contain sensitive text are deleted as a whole, and unreadable backups are conservatively deleted. This cannot be undone; export a full JSON backup first.
ui.confirm.clear_sensitive_preview: This run matches: {{anchors}} anchors, {{semantics}} preferences/facts, {{working}} working-memory lines ({{total}} total). First few matches:
ui.confirm.working_message: Removes this verbatim line from working memory immediately, regardless of the window. This cannot be undone.
ui.confirm.memory_message: Deletes this memory, its links and undo snapshot immediately, bypassing the 30-day purge wait. This cannot be undone; export JSON first.
ui.confirm.working_hits_title: This quote is still in working memory
ui.confirm.working_hits_message: Deleting the memory entry does not delete the quote: {{count}} working-memory lines still contain it (matched by text similarity, so nearby lines may match). Delete those lines too?
ui.confirm.clear_message: Permanently deletes memories, working memory, links and undo snapshots in every character database, plus the *.migrated migration backups; VACUUM then reclaims file space. This cannot be undone.
ui.confirm.clear_final_message: There is no recovery and no undo record afterwards. Continue?

ui.field.working_window.label: Working-memory lines
ui.field.working_window.help: How many verbatim lines to keep; one line each for the user and the assistant, so 8 lines is about 4 turns. Affects this plugin's private databases only.
ui.field.anchor_threshold.label: Anchor threshold (0~1)
ui.field.anchor_threshold.help: Higher keeps fewer anchors, only major events.
ui.field.max_anchor_summary_chars.label: Summary character cap
ui.field.max_anchor_summary_chars.help: Summaries may be truncated; verbatim evidence is not affected by this cap.
ui.field.hot_recall_window_days.label: Hot recall window (days)
ui.field.hot_recall_window_days.help: Recalled within this many days counts as hot.
ui.field.cold_after_days.label: Cold cooldown (days)
ui.field.cold_after_days.help: Not recalled for this many days drops to the cold tier.
ui.field.dormancy_event_days.label: Event auto-dormancy (days)
ui.field.dormancy_event_days.help: Events not confirmed for this many days go dormant; pinned items are exempt.
ui.field.dormancy_preference_days.label: Preference/fact auto-dormancy (days)
ui.field.dormancy_preference_days.help: Preferences, facts and decisions not confirmed for this many days go dormant; pinned items are exempt.
ui.field.max_recall_anchors.label: Max anchors per recall
ui.field.max_recall_anchors.help: How many anchors plus neighbours a single recall may carry.
ui.field.max_recall_semantics.label: Max semantic items per recall
ui.field.max_recall_semantics.help: How many preferences/facts a single recall may carry.
ui.field.recall_char_budget.label: Recall character budget
ui.field.recall_char_budget.help: Hard cap on characters assembled for the model on demand.
ui.field.recall_token_budget.label: Recall token budget
ui.field.recall_token_budget.help: Estimated token cap for on-demand recall; minimum 240 (a lower cap leaves only the header). CJK counts one character per token and no model tokenizer is used.
ui.field.hypothesis_retention_days.label: Hypothesis retention (days)
ui.field.hypothesis_retention_days.help: Hypothetical or role-play quotes stay in the hypothesis area only this long and are never recalled.
